name: Kophos

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

spells.name: Interplanar Teleport (At Will, Self Only, to the Universe or Netherworld only)

items.name: Painsight
items.text: A velstrac automatically knows whether a creature it sees has any of the doomed, dying, and wounded conditions, as well as the value of those conditions.

items.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic
Silent Agony
items.text: 30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it feels as if its mouth is sealing shut with excruciating pain. The creature must succeed at a DC 36 Will save save or become Stupefied 2 for 1 round. On a critical failure, it also can't make any sound with its mouth for as long as it's stupefied. This prevents it from using sonic or auditory actions that require its mouth, casting spells, and using linguistic actions. Velstracs are immune to this effect.

items.name: Bloody Epiphany
items.text: A creature hit by a kophos's chain scourge Strike must succeed at a DC 38 Fortitude save save or take 2d6 persistent,bleed damage. For as long as it is taking this persistent damage, a creature is engrossed by the pain from its own wounds and is Slowed 1. A creature stupefied by the kophos's silent agony can't willingly attempt to stop this bleeding, on itself or others. A creature that critically succeeds at its Fortitude save is temporarily immune to bloody epiphany for 24 hours.

items.name: Feed on Pain
items.text:
Requirements Three or more creatures within the kophos's silent agony aura are stupefied, slowed, or frightened

---
Effect Each of the required creatures takes 5d6 mental damage (DC 38 basic Will save save), and the kophos regains a number of Hit Points equal to the highest amount of mental damage taken.

items.name: Focus Gaze
items.text: The kophos stares at a creature it can see within 30 feet. The target must immediately attempt a Will save against silent agony. If the creature fails its save and was already stupefied, it instead begins craving pain at the hands of the kophos, taking a –2 circumstance penalty to AC against the kophos's attacks for as long as it remains stupefied. After attempting this save, the creature is then temporarily immune to Focus Gaze (but not the normal silent agony aura) until the start of the kophos's next turn.

items.name: Silent Magic
items.text: When the kophos Casts a Spell, it gains the subtle trait.

text:
Kophoses are pain purists who believe that screams and tears detract from the experience of suffering. These velstracs gouge out their eyes and cut out their tongues to make such outbursts impossible, covering the empty cavities with patches of their own skin or spiked lumps of metal, though they are still disturbingly able to see and speak. Beyond these self-inflicted injuries, they resemble typical humans, though their bodies are covered in countless gashes and scars that slowly, gruesomely heal themselves. They wrap themselves in dozens of barbed chains.

Kophoses consider it their purpose to find mortals who either inflict physical suffering on others or who are plagued with constant pain due to medical conditions and teach them how to be silent and stoic in their agony.
